name: mios_task_record
description: One line of TASKS.jsonl (repo root): the canonical record of one MiOS task, merged losslessly from every task list. Used as Responses API text.format or Chat Completions response_format.

key.description: Unique store key (the join key, like a Batch custom_id). Equals `id` unless two origins use the same id for different tasks; then `<origin>#<id>`.

id.description: The task id exactly as written in its origin list (T-NNNN, AGY-NNNN, AGY-N..M, MON-NNN, F-NNN, M-NN, CODE-NN, G-...). Never reminted.

origin.description: The list that defines the task, repo-qualified: e.g. `MiOS:TASKS.md`, `MiOS:AGY-TASKS.md`, `-dev-loop:.devloop/tasks.jsonl`.

type.description: `epic` covers id-range banners; `roadmap_item` covers ROADMAP.md CODE-NN entries.

title.description: Heading text with status/priority/size/workstream decorations removed; the original stays in sources[].text.

status.description: Normalised to OpenAI vocabulary (plan-step pending/in_progress/completed; item incomplete; response cancelled). The origin's own word stays in status_raw.

status_raw.description: The status token(s) as written in the highest-precedence source, verbatim.

workstream.description: WS-* tag(s) as written, or null.

done_when.description: Acceptance criteria (`Done When`), one entry per line as written.

verify.description: Verification commands or statements (`Verify`), as written.

type.description: `blocks` gates readiness; the rest never do.

value_json.description: The value as JSON text, unmodified.

extra.description: Every field of the defining occurrence that the typed schema does not name, in source order. The fields of every other occurrence stay in sources[].text verbatim.

conflicts.description: Values from lower-precedence sources that disagree with the typed field. Nothing is silently dropped.

sources.description: Every verbatim occurrence of this task in every source list, with provenance.
